description: A correction delivered in front of the team does work that the same correction in private does not: it establishes standing, publicly, at no cost to the person delivering it.
energy_note: The point is that everyone saw.

description: Described afterwards as candour, high standards or not standing on ceremony - all of which are real management styles, which is what makes the pattern unprovable.
energy_note: Indistinguishable from somebody having high standards.

aspect: The private praise prevents the complaint
description: Because the target is also told privately that they are valued, raising the public treatment feels like ingratitude, and they usually do not.
energy_note: Told you are valued, exactly where nobody can hear it.

description: The LIPT lists constant interruption, criticism and public humiliation among 45 mobbing actions grouped under effects on self-expression and on personal reputation - derived from 300 interviews, and unchanged as a taxonomy since.
energy_note: Named, numbered and studied for forty years.
